It encountered warning fire from the Islamic Republic of Iran’s Air Defense Force’s modern and advanced air defense systems. After executing a sharp maneuver, the aircraft was forced to alter its course and retreat from Iranian airspace. The Islamic Republic of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps warns that any attempt to bypass maritime traffic control regulations in the Strait of Hormuz is unacceptable. Continued such actions could result in heavier losses for the violators and their supporting military forces. Furthermore, it is emphasized to U.S. military commanders that Iranian airspace is a red line for the country’s armed forces. Should U.S. fighter jets repeat any violations or incursions into this airspace, they will face a decisive defensive response—one that could lead to a fate similar to that of the F-15 jet and U.S. drones previously targeted. 🔻 @enemywatch
